thread:
maria (SWE): Quick update — adoption finalized earlier than expected, need to start leave next Monday (short notice). Sorry for the scramble. Who do I need to notify and what paperwork can be fast-tracked?

sophia (People Ops): Congrats, maria!! :tada: Short-notice is ok — please file the Parental Leave Request in /leave-requests today and attach the final placement doc. We'll mark it as expedited. Key items: signed placement paperwork, completed Benefits Top-Up form, and manager sign-off. I'll queue payroll for an exception if we miss the cutoff.

maria (SWE): Thanks. Is the 100% company top-up still applied if notice is <30 days? Also need to confirm PTO usage — should I convert remaining PTO to top-up or save for after return?

sophia (People Ops): Generally the top-up applies if eligible; eligibility requires STD filing and placement docs. For short notice we'll approve the top-up retroactively if forms are in within 7 days. PTO choice is yours: you can bank it for after return or apply it concurrently with paid leave; note: if you use PTO during the leave it counts as paid leave and accrual continues. I'll DM the form links now.

harper (Eng Manager): We can handle coverage. Two asks: 1) can you drop a quick handover with active PRs + any scheduled deployments? 2) who should we page for paging issues?

maria (SWE): Will post a handover tonight. For paging, escalate to harper -> liam -> oncall rotation. Also note the inference nightly job sometimes spikes memory; I added a healthcheck flag in the runbook: `--disable-nightly-validation` if you need to pause.

liam (Recruiter): Hey — congrats, maria! Quick ops note on interviews: I can pause scheduling during your leave or route loop interviews to the hiring panel. Want me to unassign any upcoming debriefs?

maria (SWE): Yes please, pause any candidate interviews and remove me from debriefs for the next 6 weeks. Keep me copied on offers but no action required.

sophia (People Ops): Also FYI on paperwork timeline: send placement docs + leave request + benefits top-up form. Once we have manager sign-off we file STD with the insurer. People-ops-bot will change status to `Expedite` if you tag this thread with `#expedite`.

people-ops-bot: Automated checklist: [Parental Leave Request] [Placement docs uploaded] [Benefits Top-Up form] [Manager sign-off]. Visit /leave-requests to complete forms.

harper (Eng Manager): I'll review the handover tonight. maria, if you want a phased return, we can plan it now — propose a schedule and we'll approve up to 8 weeks reduced hours.

maria (SWE): Appreciate it. I'll submit the leave request now and post the handover by 9pm PT. Tagging @sophia when done. Thanks everyone :heart:
